State-by-state data shows Trump underwater in every swing state, meaning even small shifts in voter sentiment could help determine control of Congress in November.

The data comes from Civiqs’ rolling online tracking poll of 120,580 responses from registered voters.

#### Read More on Politics [...] Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.
